I am an old woman with no schooling and only this small piece of land. I grow yam and cassava the way my mother taught me, using local seeds I kept from last harvest. I do not have money to buy fertilizer or chemicals, and the rains have always been enough for my crops. My children and I will do all the work ourselves on this small plot.
